_comment_overview: Edit this file with audit findings then run: python3 ../scripts/generate_audit_report.py findings.json
_enum_soc2_tsc_prefix: CC6 — Logical & Physical Access  (use IDs SOC2-CC6.x)

findings.title: One-line actionable title
findings.description: What the issue is, why it matters, and how an attacker or operator would encounter it. 2–4 sentences. Include impact.
findings.fix: Concrete remediation steps. Reference specific code changes, env vars, or config. One paragraph max.

findings.title: Example production finding
findings.description: Describe the production-readiness issue (sync call in async path, missing retry, etc.).
findings.fix: Wrap in run_in_executor / add tenacity retries / pin dependency / etc.

findings.title: Example SOC2 finding — control criterion in title is helpful
findings.description: Map the gap to the specific TSC. Note: SOC2 findings often overlap with Security/Production findings — that is intended. The SOC2 sheet frames them through the audit lens.
